messages:
rachael_sales: Heads-up: EMEA reseller BlueSpan requested a stacked commercial to win a regulated telco POC. Asking for urgent deal-desk + finance review. @igor_partnerships @sam_dealdesk

igor_partnerships: what's the ask vs our EU rate card? link?

rachael_sales: they want 27% off list for a 45-day POC, plus a 10% \"admin uplift\" on top of partner margin (effectively increasing their take). Standard EU partner discount is 20%. They also want partner-managed invoicing.

sam_dealdesk: need quick margin delta and CRM opp id. If partner invoices we need remittance & audit clauses.

rachael_sales: CRM: RDW-EU-9982. POC est $36k. Proposed: 27% POC discount, admin uplift 10% of net, partner commission stays 18% on net.

nidhi_finance: finance flag: admin uplift + partner invoicing compresses margin and creates AR/recon risk. Need RevOps delta plus whether uplift is refundable (clawback) if commit not met. Also confirm VAT handling.

ben_ps: PS estimate ~32 hours; require SOC2 summary + DPA before env access. If uplift doesn't cover PS, request PS voucher.

igor_partnerships: I'm open to a time-limited concession if we get: 1) signed addendum with MDF/clawback language, 2) partner remittance schedule + audit rights, 3) SOC2/DPA before kickoff, 4) finance + deal-desk signoff.

sam_dealdesk: Opening ticket DD-10620 to track. Please attach CRM opp, quick calc, SOW, and proposed clawback language. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10620

deal-bot: DD-10620 created  status: Open  awaiting finance + legal review.

rachael_sales: uploading SOW + draft addendum to DD-10620. Will ask partner to accept invoice credit flow and sign addendum before POC start. Thanks all :pray:
